_doc: Text the hack's intro routine (0x775xxx) reaches as anchor+imm8 (GCC section anchors), so no pointer scan finds it and it cannot simply be repointed. Each block: allocate room for the strings, write them at base+off, set the literal word to base, and apply Thumb patches (orig bytes asserted).

strings.zh:
哎呀，久等了！{FB}欢迎来到
口袋妖怪的世界！{FB}我叫大木，{FB}大家都亲切地称我为
精灵博士。
strings.en:
Oh, sorry to keep you
waiting!{FB}Welcome to the
world of Pokémon!{FB}My name is Oak.{FB}People fondly call me
the Pokémon Professor.

strings.zh:
但是，我们并没有了解
精灵的一切。{FB}精灵身上还有很多
秘密等待我们解决！{FB}为了弄清这些谜团，
我每天都要进行{FA}精灵的相关研究！{FB}
strings.en:
But we still don't know
everything about them.{FB}Pokémon hold many
secrets yet to uncover!{FB}To unravel them, I
research Pokémon{FA}every single day!{FB}

patch.asm: movs r2,r1 -> ldr r2,[pc,#0x2b0] (literal 7761CC); greeting = base+0x2E
